top_creatures.label: Weave-sprinter
top_creatures.why: Readable S-shape silhouette at 375 wide; one signature behaviour: sway, then a lunge at 2 tiles
top_creatures.change: body shape, colour, add a rear-up telegraph before the lunge

top_creatures.label: Rally drummer
top_creatures.why: A caller that changes other enemies' goals, so a fight escalates
top_creatures.keep: rally radius scaling with tier; timed attack goal
top_creatures.change: trigger from a banner or totem, not only a self-heal roll; visible rally ring
top_creatures.ref: Source/monster.cpp:2334-2357 (FallenAi rally); M_FallenFear at 4450; monstdat.tsv lines 6-17

top_creatures.label: Fade-kite warlock
top_creatures.why: A learnable cycle of retreat, vanish and return
top_creatures.keep: retreat under half HP then fade back in; missile type picked by tier
top_creatures.change: fade visual; short wind-up before each vanish

top_creatures.label: Winged guardian
top_creatures.why: Retreats then heals, so the player must chase it
top_creatures.keep: retreat until a range threshold, then heal
top_creatures.change: heal from a relic or pool, not a free self-heal

top_creatures.label: Ambush hider
top_creatures.why: Fade-in and fade-out at fixed distances is a strong silhouette tell
top_creatures.change: fade colour; tell sound (audio files absent, not judged)

top_creatures.label: Storm caster
top_creatures.why: Distance-keeping caster that creates space in a fight
top_creatures.change: remove the always-true walk branch (defect); add a telegraph
top_creatures.ref: Source/monster.cpp:2013-2068 (AiRangedAvoidance), defect at 2052-2053, missile at 1966; monstdat.tsv lines 70-81

top_creatures.label: Flame hulk
top_creatures.why: Big ranged area threat with a melee fallback

top_creatures.label: Final boss (single row)
top_creatures.why: 1666 max HP, 60 max damage, knockback flag, and a fixed special damage in code
top_creatures.change: use a phase structure we design; the donor has one row only

originals.name: Coil Stalker
originals.idea: a weave-then-lunge pursuer that lunges at two tiles
originals.change: zigzag with pauses, our silhouette, a wind-up tell

originals.name: Rally Drummer
originals.idea: a caller that rallies allies in a radius that grows with tier
originals.keep: radius scaling and the timed attack goal
originals.change: triggered by a banner object; visible ring

originals.name: Fade-kite Warlock
originals.idea: retreats under half HP, vanishes, returns, picks a missile by tier
originals.keep: the cycle and the tier-picked missile

originals.name: Zone Director (parity row 23)
originals.idea: population from walkable area divided by a constant; group size by depth; leashed boss escort within 3 tiles
originals.change: fix the group walk (deltaY); add despawn on empty with a grace timer and respawn timers, which this donor lacks

originals.name: Zone Glow
originals.idea: per-zone palette cycling at different rates
originals.keep: cheap ambience with no extra sprites

originals.name: Alignment-locked affixes
originals.idea: prefix and suffix rolls with a useful-only restriction and a good or evil lock
originals.keep: the lock and the useful-only restriction

originals.name: Level-scaled crit
originals.idea: critical chance equal to character level percent, doubling damage
originals.change: cap near 20 percent and tie it to a class trait
